attributes.name: Audio Aux
attributes.description: Sends the document's program mix or a custom mix to a separate audio output device.

attributes.name: Fullscreen
attributes.description: Sends the program output to an external display via Thunderbolt or HDMI.

attributes.name: Last Recording Uploader
attributes.description: Uploads the last file recording to a file storage service.

attributes.name: Blackmagic Design
attributes.description: Sends the program output to a Blackmagic Design device.

attributes.name: File Recording
attributes.description: Writes the program output to a file on disk.

attributes.name: Image Writer
attributes.description: Writes single frames of any video source to an image file on disk.

attributes.name: Live Streaming
attributes.description: Streams the program output live on Facebook, YouTube, Twitch or any other RTMP ingest service.

attributes.name: NDI®
attributes.description: Creates an NDI® sender that broadcasts the program output on the network.

attributes.name: Virtual Camera
attributes.description: Allows other apps on this machine to use the program output as a camera source.

attributes.name: mimoCall
attributes.description: Sends the program output to a another mimoCall TVSource.
